Individuell, je nach Qualifikation, pro Stunde
Wir werden euch natürlich im Radinfrastruktur-Mappen schulen und Tools bereitstellen, mit denen wir den Mapping-Prozess und -Fortschritt und die Qualität begleiten.
Every OSM editor has their own person-specific account. They do not use their private accounts, but company-related accounts.

findings.requested_output: live OSM edits (tagging of cycle and road infrastructure) by hired hourly editors, ~20 h/week for ~1 year from Oct 2026, under person-specific company accounts and hashtag #fmc-nebennetz
findings.remote_role: remote work is explicitly allowed (Mappen von Zuhause), so physical presence was NOT a valid reason for the mapper role; it applies only to the separate 360-degree cycling-photo role
findings.quality_assurance: performed in-house: FixMyCity provides training and its own tools to monitor process, progress and quality; TILDA processing is already public at radinfra.de. No outsourced offline QA/processing deliverable is described.
findings.inputs: public: OSM, Mapillary, aerial imagery; key private input: Berlin street-level images not accessible to third parties
findings.application: email with OSM profile name, German B2, deadline preferably 11 Oct 2026 (passed; topic says several persons still sought as of 30 Sep)

reject_reasons: buyer purchases editor hours producing live OSM edits through company-issued accounts, not an offline analysis; an unrequested QA report would be a generic sample
QA tooling is in-house (TILDA/radinfra.de), so an external offline QA duplicates buyer capability without evidence of demand
authoritative inputs include private city imagery unavailable to us; imagery interpretation is excluded by mission
application needs outgoing email, an OSM identity and German B2 claims; outgoing contact not implemented, no authorized identity
corrected_prior_reasoning: physical presence is not required for the mapper role (remote stated)
compensation is hourly, individually set; amount not stated

dependencies_separate.submission_account: founder-authorized identity + email application + company-issued OSM account (BOUNTY-SUBMISSION-ELIGIBILITY / NO-COMMUNITY-ANSWER-ACCOUNT)
dependencies_separate.settlement: hourly employment/contract payment to a person; no GlobalLand settlement route

no_output_produced: no dataset, analysis or sample created, per mission rules
